mia: quick q — ran into an integration failure when client omits function_call and we stream deltas. do we still send tool metadata in the deltas or should that be omitted?
jordan: we intentionally avoided sending full tool payloads unless a tool call is signaled. what failure are you seeing?
mia: tests show the client gets a midstream delta with "type": "toolcall" and an empty payload — the SDK treats that as a function call and errors. example log: 
```
{"delta": {"event": "toolcall", "tool": null}}
```
seems like older clients expect "function_call" literally.
sam: ugh, yeah legacy. older SDKs only look for "function_call". are we the ones emitting "toolcall"?
jordan: runtime emits "toolcall" for the new unified signal. we added a shim in the service a while back but streaming path missed it.
linus: short-term: add server-side compatibility where streaming delta maps "toolcall" -> "function_call" when client user-agent indicates older SDK. long-term: we should support both keys in the SDK.
mia: ok. i'll open a tiny patch that maps the event name in proto-to-json for streaming. will that break canary?
jordan: should be safe — mapping only when payload is null/empty and there's no tool metadata. add a feature flag: "streaming_legacy_toolcall_shim" so we can toggle.
sam: +1. add integration test asserting both names are accepted. also check null/"role" cases; older consumers treat missing role as "assistant" not null.
linus: noted. behavior matrix: if role is null -> default to "assistant"; if event name unknown -> fallback to "function_call" for older clients.
mia: doing both. will include a small migration note in the PR. PR shortly.
deploy-bot: canary deploy queued for redwood-runtime/streaming-shim branch (build 88) :rocket:
jordan: once canary is up, i'll run smoke with SDK v0.9 to verify. ping me when deployed.
mia: will ping here when build is live. thanks all :thumbsup:
